description: Na₃MoN₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.61 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four N atoms to form distorted NaN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four MoN₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.53 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.84 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.65 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.63 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.83 Å. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to four N atoms to form MoN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaN₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent MoN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mo-N bond distances ranging from 1.80-1.95 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to four N atoms to form MoN₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaN₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent MoN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mo-N bond distances ranging from 1.80-1.94 Å. There are six inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Mo atom. In the second N site, N is bonded to five Na and one Mo atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NNa₅Mo octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-57°. In the third N site, N is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Mo atom. In the fourth N site, N is bonded to five Na and one Mo atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NNa₅Mo octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-57°. In the fifth N site, N is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Mo atoms. In the sixth N site, N is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Mo atoms.
